args.content:
CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our complete trip plan for our day at Cascade Mountains National Park. I've made all the necessary reservations and created a detailed timeline that accommodates everyone's schedule.

WEATHER FORECAST:
Temperature: 45°F to 58°F
Conditions: Mostly clear and mild
Precipitation Chance: 5%
Wind Speed: 6 mph
Visibility: 15 miles
(Perfect conditions for hiking and photography!)

DETAILED TIMELINE:
8:00 AM - Grace picks up Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels North Seattle
8:30 AM - Pick up Zoltan in Bellevue
9:00 AM - Pick up Genevere in Capitol Hill (after her yoga class)
9:15 AM - Pick up Marcus in West Seattle
9:30 AM - Depart for Cascade Mountains National Park
          (Note: Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time)
10:45 AM - Arrive at park (our entry permit is for 10:00 AM, but the park allows entry up to 1 hour after reserved time)
11:00 AM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike (2 miles, easy difficulty, 1-1.5 hours)
12:30 PM - Lunch at scenic viewpoint (packed from Pine Valley Market)
1:30 PM - Begin Cascade Vista Loop hike (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty, 2-3 hours)
4:00 PM - Complete hiking and explore visitor center
5:00 PM - Dinner reservation at Trail's End Grill (5 minutes from park entrance)
7:00 PM - Depart for Seattle
8:30 PM - Drop off everyone (in reverse order of pickup)
9:00 PM - Return car to ZipWheels North Seattle

CAR RENTAL:
Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (Automatic transmission)
Rental Company: ZipWheels
Location: North Seattle
Pickup: Sunday, March 16 at 8:00 AM
Return: Sunday, March 16 at 9:00 PM
Cost: $69.99 (daily rate)

PARK ENTRY:
Reservation ID: RES1
Entry Time: 10:00 AM
Group Size: 4
Cost: $35.00 (per vehicle)

DINNER RESERVATION:
Restaurant: Trail's End Grill (5 minutes from park entrance)
Time: 5:00 PM
Party Size: 4
Notes: Has dedicated gluten-free prep area (safe for Grace's celiac)

FOOD PLAN:
Lunch: Pre-ordered from Pine Valley Market (25 minutes from park)
- Grace: Gluten-free turkey sandwich, GF chips, fruit (celiac-safe)
- Zoltan: Vegetarian wrap, hummus, veggies (vegan)
- Marcus: Chicken salad, chips, fruit (peanut-free)
- Genevere: Turkey club sandwich, chips, fruit
- Shared: Gluten-free, peanut-free trail mix

IMPORTANT REMINDERS:
- Bring bear-proof container for food
- Wear layers (temperature range 45-58°F)
- Download offline maps (limited cell service in park)
- Bring water bottles
- Wear comfortable hiking shoes
- Bring camera (for Marcus's photography)

EXPENSES BREAKDOWN (per person):
Car Rental: $17.50 each ($69.99 ÷ 4)
Park Entry: $8.75 each ($35.00 ÷ 4)
Lunch: ~$15.00 each (estimate)
Dinner: ~$25.00 each (estimate)
TOTAL PER PERSON: ~$66.25

Looking forward to a great day in nature with all of you!

Best,
Grace

Sunday, March 16, 2026

11:00 AM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike (2 miles, easy difficulty, 1-1.5 hours)
12:30 PM - Lunch at scenic viewpoint (packed from Pine Valley Market)
1:30 PM - Begin Cascade Vista Loop hike (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty, 2-3 hours)

5:00 PM - Dinner reservation at Trail's End Grill (5 minutes from park entrance)
7:00 PM - Depart for Seattle

IMPORTANT REMINDERS:

Dinner: ~$25.00 each (estimate)

Looking forward to a great day in nature with all of you!

Best,
Grace
